title: P450 cyptide synthase MpoB catalyzes the cross-linking of the YPW motif on the precursor peptide
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00153F, Communication

Abujunaid Habib Khan, Jabal Rahmat Haedar, Vic Kiselov, Viktors Romanuks, Gints Smits, Stefano Donadio, Chin-Soon Phan
The uncharacterized cytochrome P450 cyptide synthase MpoB from Micromonospora polyrhachis DSM 45886 catalyzes a cross-link between Tyr-C3 and Trp-N1 at the YPW motif on the precursor peptide MpoA.
